ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, the line $y=ax+6$ intersects the line $y=2x$ at point A ($m, 4$), and it intersects the x-axis at point B, and the y-axis at point C. Calculate the area of $\triangle AOC$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the diagram, draw a perpendicular line from A to the y-axis with the foot at D, thus $AD=2$,\\
when $x=0$, we have $y=-x+6=6$,\\
$\therefore$ the coordinates of point C are $(0,6)$\\
$\therefore$ the area of $\triangle AOC$ is $\frac{1}{2}\times 6\times 2=\boxed{6}$.
